annotations.title: US SEC EDGAR XBRL Financials, 8-K Catalyst & K-Supply-Chain Radar

description: [$0.03 USDC via x402] Official US SEC EDGAR submissions, decoded Form 8-K material items (earnings, M&A, restatements), standardized US-GAAP/IFRS XBRL financials (revenue, net income, EPS, CapEx YoY), and Korea supply-chain peers.

cik.description: Optional SEC Central Index Key (1-10 digits, e.g. 0001045810 for NVIDIA) when querying directly by CIK.

items.description: SEC form code such as 8-K, 10-Q, 10-K, 20-F, or 6-K

include_xbrl.description: Whether to extract standardized US-GAAP/IFRS XBRL financial metrics and YoY growth (default true).

limit.description: Maximum number of recent matched filings to return (1..20, default 8).

ticker.description: US stock ticker symbol (e.g. NVDA, AAPL, MU, AVGO, MSFT, TSLA, CEG). Either ticker or cik is required.
